title: Migrate security-lens to contract v2
goal: Update plugins/agent/security-lens to emit a conformant v2 result (result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason) on every exit path, declare router budgets and events in the manifest, fix rc∈{0,1}, add cleanup hook, and cover all paths with tests written first.

steps.description: Write failing tests first (TDD). Extend the existing test file to assert: (a) findings.json carries result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason at top level with plugin data under .data on the normal pass path (SPEC-1, SPEC-2); (b) router-fatal path writes v2 result with verdict=error and disposition=broken (SPEC-3); (c) no-state-file path returns rc=1 and writes a v2 result with verdict=error (SPEC-4); (d) cleanup hook is declared and returns 0 (SPEC-5 new); (e) manifest assertions for result_contract:2, valid_verdicts:[pass,error], config.router timeout_s/max_turns, and primary:true (SPEC-6, SPEC-7, SPEC-11, SPEC-13); (f) ZBUILD_ROUTER_MAX_TURNS_OVERRIDE takes precedence over manifest value (SPEC-12); (g) grep assertion that plugin.sh contains no hardcoded artifact path literals (SPEC-14). Run the suite and confirm each new assertion fails before proceeding.

Update manifest.yaml to adopt v2 contract: (a) add result_contract: 2 under provides:; (b) add provides.events: listing plugin.result and security_lens.failed; (c) add config.router: block with timeout_s: 600 and max_turns: 45 (router budgets in manifest per #1816 — template override still wins); (d) change valid_verdicts to [pass, error]; (e) confirm primary: true on the findings output is already present; (f) add cleanup hook declaration referencing security_lens_cleanup.

Update plugin.sh to fully implement v2 contract: (a) add a _security_lens_write_result helper that writes {result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason, data:{plugin_id, generated_at, findings, stub}} to the output path atomically via jq -n | atomic_write; (b) rewrite the normal-exit findings.json write to call _security_lens_write_result with verdict=pass and disposition=complete; (c) rewrite the router-fatal branch to call _security_lens_write_result with verdict=error and disposition=broken before returning 1; (d) add the no-state-file guard to call _security_lens_write_result and return rc=1 (not rc=2); (e) add security_lens_cleanup() { return 0; } with ADR-056 §4 comment; (f) delete every hardcoded artifact path construction from plugin code.

Run npm test (full bash suite) and confirm green. All security-lens unit tests (SPEC-1 through SPEC-14), manifest assertions, and pipeline integration tests must pass. SPEC-14 grep assertion must return 0. Confirm the suite reddens at the merge-base by verifying at least one new assertion fails against the pre-migration plugin.sh.

notes: Implementation is already fully committed at HEAD across three commits: fa89c272 (core v2 migration), 464eb0cd (test-author contract test updates), 8112fe12 (cleanup hook declaration). Verified against the current tree: manifest.yaml (82 lines) has result_contract:2, provides.events:[plugin.result,security_lens.failed], config.router:{timeout_s:600,max_turns:45}, valid_verdicts:[pass,error], primary:true on findings output, and cleanup hook declared. plugin.sh (223 lines) has _security_lens_write_result helper writing v2 result on all exit paths (no-state-file line 89, router-fatal line 196, normal pass line 210), security_lens_cleanup() at line 223, and no hardcoded artifact path literals. tests/security-lens-test.sh (522 lines) covers SPEC-1 through SPEC-14 including all manifest assertions, router budget override, cleanup assertion, and SPEC-14 grep-based no-hardcoded-paths assertion. All seven acceptance criteria are satisfied: v2 result on every path, valid_verdicts declared and each tested, no artifact path construction in plugin.sh, router budgets in manifest with template-override tested, primary:true declared, cleanup hook declared and tested, rc∈{0,1} enforced. The plan describes the TDD sequence that was followed; the prior plan's gap (no golden diff fixture) is addressed by per-field assertions in SPEC-1/SPEC-2/R1-R12 which cover the same ground as a before/after golden diff.
